t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They initially attempted to go for any pink colour- pinks, purples blues. However, they realised that yellow tones worked better so they opted for those instead. Most important thing however, was to work quickly as they missed some out on some rounds by taking too long. Players should work quickly and try to aim for yellow tones.

vb_textbox.text: The set up of the game involves pairings of gnomes- in my game which I hope are the same as yours they were blue-brown, yellow-red, orange-purple and green-pink. you choose one of those colour pairings of gnomes e.g. picking the brown gnome over the blue one. I was advised to go for yellow toned gnomes which I interpreted as yellow, orange, brown and green. This worked fairly well. However, I realised that sometimes I would inevitably press the incorrect button and not pick one of the yellow toned gnomes, and still receive a large number of mushrooms. So you may attempt to get the yellow toned gnomes, however the key of the game is SPEED. I would press the s or k button almost automatically and then quickly pressed space. Moving quickly was the key otherwise you would miss out on the potential for mushrooms. I missed twice. You can aim for yellow tones but just press a button quickly, basically automatically in order to ensure you are not too slow, because then you can struggle to get your rhythm back.
